title: Incremental value of repaired exterior information under noisy anchors
orientation: Use the edge-magnitude-weighted vote of all query-incident noisy anchor signs combined with the spectral observed-node gauge estimate.
comparison: For each realized inferred query orientation, compare the same reconstructed graph with exterior-exterior messages enabled versus disabled. Thus anchor errors and query-edge reconstruction are identical between policies.
primary: At anchor error 0.10, full repaired exterior must beat reconstructed local-only with paired-seed lower 95% sign-accuracy bound >0.
scope: This isolates incremental exterior value conditional on the same anchor-derived orientation. It does not compare against an oracle with true query-edge signs.
